title: Text
description: Reference schema for docs/timeline/SPEC.md §7.1's Text node type: 'with WritingSystem link, decipherment_status (DECIPHERED|PARTIAL|UNDECIPHERED|DISPUTED), witness chain (composition vs. manuscript).' Entities aggregate claims; every substantive statement about a Text lives in a linked Claim (subject_type: Text, subject_id: this entity's id), not inline here. The hand-rolled validator (docs/timeline/scripts/validate-timeline.mjs) is authoritative if this file and the validator diverge.

name.description: Common name, e.g. 'Rosetta Stone', 'Popol Vuh (K'iche' manuscript tradition)'.

writing_system_id.description: Id of the WritingSystem entity this text is written in.

decipherment_status.description: SPEC.md §7.1. DECIPHERED = the script and language are both read with scholarly consensus. PARTIAL = signs/sounds are read but the underlying language is poorly understood, or vice versa (e.g. Meroitic: phonetic values known since 1909, the Meroitic language itself still largely unparsed). UNDECIPHERED = no scholarly consensus reading exists. DISPUTED = competing decipherment claims exist without consensus resolution.

witness_chain.description: Composition date and physical-witness (manuscript/inscription) date are frequently centuries or millennia apart and must never be collapsed into one date (mirrors this project's TraditionDating discipline, SPEC.md §5.2).

earliest_witness_date.description: Earliest surviving physical manuscript/inscription, as distinct from composition_date.
